latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Highlight Editor HD — Extract and Export HD Highlights.

- Convert raw video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV up to 500MB) into HD highlight reels.
- Supports cloud-based AI highlight extraction and export to 1080p MP4 in 1-2 minutes.
- Simple session setup with automatic token management (no user credentials required).
- Action routing based on user prompts for exporting, uploading, credits, and more.
- Clear error handling and workflow guidance for uploads, edits, and exports.
